name: forge-workout-tracker
description: FORGE — Strength OS progressive overload tracker

scripts.cap:init: node node_modules/@capacitor/cli/bin/capacitor init FORGE com.forge.strengthos --web-dir dist
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && node node_modules/@capacitor/cli/bin/capacitor sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
